name: ai-agent-plugin
description: Dreamon's collection of agent skills for coding agents — starting with macOS App Screenshot.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshot any macOS app window by name
interface.longDescription: Capture a retina, shadow-free screenshot of any macOS app's frontmost window by app name. The agent resolves the window automatically, captures at 2x, and can convert captures to WebP for the web.
defaultPrompt: Capture the Safari window and convert it to WebP
